# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 90 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 90 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_090_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 7

**1** "And the fifth mountain that had green grass and was rugged — these are those who believed and are faithful, but are hard to please; they are bold and self-satisfied, and want to understand everything, but they understand nothing at all. **2** Because of their boldness understanding has left them; and there is recklessness mixed in them with rashness. These therefore are in the rocks of the mountain. **3** Yet God is not displeased with them, for they are good men, but they have a certain hardness of character; if therefore they restrain themselves and understand true meekness, they can have repentance. **4** "And the sixth mountain that had cracks, some large and some small — these are those who have believed; the ones in the small cracks are those who quarrel among themselves and are weak in the faith. And those in the large cracks are bold in their wickedness and full of themselves; to these repentance is available, but it is hard, and they shall live with difficulty." **5** "The seventh mountain that had green and cheerful grass on which cattle and all kinds of animals were feeding and with birds also — these are those who believed and are innocent and guiltless, who were never divided in their hearts and who always walk in gladness. **6** But the eighth mountain that was full of springs, and from which all kinds of creatures were watered — these are the apostles and teachers who preached the name of the Son of God, and having fulfilled their commission, fell asleep in the power and holiness of the Son of God."

---

*EMET: mountains 5-8 progress from difficult-but-salvageable to fully glorious. Mountain 8 = apostles and teachers — the fountainhead of the community's life.*
